extension.name: WXL Shoulder Camera - Lux Replacement
extension.description: Per-character settings keyed by realm and GUID, adjustable race defaults based on preserved human settings, and remembered normal camera distance; retain transport, interaction and combat fixes. Read-only interaction camera service for companion staging. Adjustable gun recoil and gentle bow recoil/shake; crossbows unchanged. Bow release uses a single smooth sway and gentler, slower kick. Horizontal reticle facing with drawn melee weapons; native movement, animation timing and free-look retained.
